snippet.title: Tellyport (Trailer 2025)
snippet.description:
Graduation Video Game
School : ISART DIGITAL, the Video Game and 3D Animation / VFX School 

Platform: PC
Engine: Unreal Engine 5.4.4
Number of players: 1
Genre: Puzzle - Physics-based Puzzle

Play as Sally, the granddaughter of a brilliant and eccentric inventor, who invited you to explore her 70s lab, filled with unique inventions.

Solve puzzles by crossing TV screens that alter your gravity, size, or both. Observation, manipulation, and thinking are key to progressing!

--

Incarnez Sally, petite-fille d’une inventrice excentrique, et résolvez les énigmes
parsemant son laboratoire des années 70.

Traversez des télévisions altérant votre gravité, votre taille ou les deux pour résoudre des énigmes. Manipulation, observation et réflexion sont essentielles pour progresser !

Ready to play Tellyport? Visit https://isart-digital.itch.io/tellyport

Producer: Alice CAPRON, Martin BRIDENNE
Game Art: Aurèle BOUVIER, Louis BERTRAND, Manon LABERDURE, David PINHEIRO, Martin PIERRET
Game Design: Axel BASSELIER-MARCHAL, Loïc SAINTILAN, Tristan LEFEBURE, Melanie RODRIGUES PENTEADO
Game Design & Programming: David GUTIÉRREZ DÍAZ, Iris SEBIROT
Game Programming: Romain BOURGOGNE, Vincent DEVINE, Quentin LEPINE
Music & Sound Design: Marie CLERC, Nathan CIMIA
Marketing Manager: Yueyuan LI
